caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic mug, centrally positioned on the page. The mug is cylindrical with a slightly wider base and rim, both of which are accentuated with distinct horizontal bands. It has a smooth, reflective surface that suggests it is made of metal. Attached to the mug on the right side is a curved handle, which begins at the rim and connects toward the bottom of the mug with a looped end. The drawing is rendered in monochromatic shades of grey, using shading to represent reflections and contours, and it is set against a plain, light background. There is a handwritten name, "Aaron Fastovsky," in cursive at the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Silver Mug
